description: This file defines the AttendanceConfigurationModel class, which implements the Normalizable interface to serialize attendance configuration data for the OrangeHRM attendance plugin. It provides methods to access and convert an AttendanceConfiguration object into an array suitable for API responses.

classes.name: AttendanceConfigurationModel
classes.description: A model class representing attendance configuration data, serializable for API output, encapsulating an AttendanceConfiguration object.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the model with an AttendanceConfiguration object.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Serializes the attendance configuration data into associative array for API responses.
